data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $75,625,000 (2021: $60,654,000) is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2021: deterioration $5,306,000).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on 2019 and 2020 underwriting years leading to an increase in gross incurred claims estimates for those years.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1971 recorded gross prior-year adverse development of approximately 25.47 million (USD) on underwriting years 2019-2020 (an increase of about 13.7% versus opening gross claims outstanding). The movement reflects backyear deterioration driven by recalibration of IBNR and reserving assumptions, allowance for inflationary pressures and adjustments to methodology, primarily affecting its motor and thirdparty liability business.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $75,625,000 (2021: $60,654,000) is a deterioration of $10,434,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2021: deterioration $5,306,000).

The implications of this analysis have been incorporated into our reserving approach for all years of account, which together with a loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates, has contributed to the back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account on a stand-alone basis.
the assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (25.471m) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross incurred claims by underwriting year). The narrative states a deterioration of 10.434m but that sentence refers to 'net calendar year claims incurred' and appears to be a net/reinsuranceaffected figure; the gross triangle yields a larger adverse movement. All monetary figures reported above are in the syndicate's native currency (USD). Triangle and balance sheet amounts in the report are presented in thousands; amounts above converted to millions. Confidence levels reflect source reliability (balance sheet = 1.0; triangle calculation = 0.8).
